final: WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT f.rating, AVG(f.length) as avg_length, AVG(f.rental_rate / f.rental_duration) as per_day_rate FROM film f WHERE f.length IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.rating), mean_rate AS (SELECT AVG(per_day_rate) as mean_per_day_rate FROM rating_stats), above_mean AS (SELECT rs.rating, rs.avg_length, rs.per_day_rate, (rs.per_day_rate - mr.mean_per_day_rate) as excess FROM rating_stats rs, mean_rate mr WHERE rs.per_day_rate > mr.mean_per_day_rate) SELECT AVG(avg_length) as avg_of_avg_lengths, AVG(per_day_rate) as avg_of_per_day_rates, AVG(excess) as avg_excess FROM above_mean
